home.title: AstroConnect 2026
home.subtitle: Beijing Joint Astrophysics Postdoc Forum
home.heroVenue: KIAA, Peking University & Department of Astronomy, Tsinghua University · Beijing, China
home.overviewText: AstroConnect 2026 is a joint astrophysics postdoc forum hosted by the Kavli Institute for Astronomy and Astrophysics at Peking University (KIAA) and the Department of Astronomy at Tsinghua University (DoA). The forum aims to bring together postdoctoral researchers from across Beijing to share work in progress, exchange ideas and explore potential collaborations. The programme includes talks, poster sessions and ample time for discussion. Undergraduate and graduate students are also welcome.
home.scopeIntro: We welcome contributions across observational, theoretical and computational astrophysics. The areas below are examples. Submissions on other topics in astronomy and astrophysics are equally welcome.

scope.galaxies: Galaxy formation and evolution, extragalactic astronomy and cosmology
scope.stars: Stellar structure and evolution, star formation and stellar populations
scope.planets: Exoplanetary systems, planet formation and protoplanetary discs
scope.compact: Compact objects, high-energy phenomena and gravitational-wave astrophysics
scope.methods: Astronomical instrumentation, statistical inference and machine learning

home.formatIntro: The planned programme combines research presentations with ample time for questions, interaction and discussion.
home.talksText: Each talk consists of a 12-minute presentation followed by 3 minutes for questions.
home.postersText: Poster sessions for detailed research exchanges, including a 1-minute flash talk for each poster.
home.breaksText: Ample coffee-break time will allow participants to follow up on presentations, visit posters and continue informal conversations.
home.discussionsText: Separate sessions will be reserved for focused discussion. Potential themes include scientific questions, AI in research, career development and work–life balance.
home.formatNote: The programme will be announced on {announcementDate}.
home.kiaaVenue: 14 December · Kavli Institute for Astronomy and Astrophysics (KIAA), Peking University
home.doaVenue: 15 December · Department of Astronomy (DoA), Tsinghua University
home.deadlineTime: Abstracts and attend-only registrations are due by 23:59 Beijing time (UTC+8) on their respective dates.
home.registrationHelp: Use the Tencent Docs form to register for the forum and submit a talk or poster abstract.
home.meals: Lunch is provided, along with dinner on the first day (14 December).

program.title: Programme
program.intro: AstroConnect 2026 takes place on 14–15 December 2026 in Beijing. The planned programme includes approximately 20 research talks (12 minutes + 3 minutes Q&A), 25 posters, extended coffee breaks and dedicated discussion sessions. The programme will be announced on {announcementDate}.
program.notice: The 2025 speaker list is not the 2026 programme.
program.talksText: Approximately 20 talks are planned. Each speaker has 12 minutes for the presentation and 3 minutes for questions.
program.postersText: Approximately 25 posters are planned. Each poster presenter will give a 1-minute flash talk.
program.discussionText: Dedicated discussion sessions and extended coffee breaks will provide time for scientific exchanges and topics suggested by participants.
program.ctaText: Use the Tencent Docs form to register and submit your abstract.
